items.title: Initialise repository and Python project layout
items.description: Create the git repo, pyproject.toml with a src/ layout, .gitignore (venv, __pycache__, .env, *.db), a README stub and .env.example.
ac: Fresh clone installs in a clean virtualenv

items.title: Set up test, lint and type-check tooling
items.description: Configure pytest, ruff and mypy in pyproject.toml and add one smoke test.

items.title: Add CI pipeline
items.description: Run lint, type-check and tests on every pull request and push to main using the CI system named in DEV_OPS.md.
ac: Workflow runs on pull requests and on push to main
A failing test turns the check red

items.title: Configuration and secrets handling
items.description: Load settings from environment variables with validation; keep .env out of git and document every variable in .env.example.
ac: A missing required variable fails fast with a clear message

items.title: Walking skeleton
items.description: Build the thinnest end-to-end slice that runs: {skeleton}
ac: The slice runs end to end locally
It is covered by at least one automated test
